note: Initial 10 development questions only. No held-out test set has been created. Do not index questions, answers or evidence review files as source documents.

questions.question: How does the 2025 report describe the platform supporting International Consumer Banking's European expansion?
expected_answer_points: Multi-country digital business; one cloud-native platform supports European expansion.
ICB includes more than the UK business; do not generalize this platform description to all group systems.

questions.question: What customer and balance figures does the 2025 report disclose for Chase UK?
expected_answer_points: 2.8 million customers; balances above $35 billion.
Attribute figures to this report; do not assign an unprovided exact measurement date or currency conversion.

questions.question: Does ICB's appearance in the CCB letter mean its initiatives are financially reported in CCB?
expected_answer_points: No. Narrative placement and financial reporting scope differ.
The footnote places international consumer initiatives in Corporate; the text distinguishes ICB and CCB strategies.

questions.question: Compare the digital customer metrics in the 2024 and 2025 CCB reports. Do these passages establish identical definitions?
expected_answer_points: 2024: approximately 71m digitally active customers, reported 6% year-over-year growth.
2025: 75m digital engagement, reported 5% growth.
Preserve labels and approximation. These passages alone do not establish identical definitions or justify an exact growth calculation.

questions.question: How do the 2024 and 2025 CCB disclosures describe data, cloud and AI priorities?
expected_answer_points: 2024 emphasizes cloud migration, data quality, readiness and broader AI platform use.
2025 discusses cloud-hosted data and expanding generative/agentic applications.
Compare disclosures; do not assert uniform performance improvement or UK applicability.

questions.question: What does the 2024 report say about LLM Suite's rollout and data protection?
expected_answer_points: Rollout during 2024 exceeded 200,000 colleagues worldwide.
Controlled access protects customer/company data and supports enterprise workflows.

questions.question: Can International Consumer Banking be treated as synonymous with Chase UK?
expected_answer_points: No. The passage describes a multi-country business, UK operations and broader European expansion.
Use the UK label only for facts explicitly tied to the UK.

questions.question: Does the group-wide 2024 LLM Suite disclosure prove that every Chase UK employee used it?
expected_answer_points: No UK-specific universal usage conclusion follows from the group rollout figure.
State the evidence limit, rather than claiming that UK adoption did or did not occur.

questions.question: How many customers does Chase have?
expected_answer_points: Ask for report year, business/geographic scope and customer metric before selecting a number.

questions.question: How many Chase UK customers are there today, as of October 24, 2026?
expected_answer_points: The fixed annual-report corpus does not verify a live count on that date.
The 2025-report figure may be offered as historical disclosure with its source, not as today's count.
